biography.plain_text: Alexey Mordashov is a Russian billionaire industrialist, Severstal chairman and majority shareholder. The son of workers at its Cherepovets mill, he returned as an economist, became finance director during privatisation and used investment funds to acquire employee shares. He modernised and expanded the steelmaker as chief executive before moving to board leadership.

long_biography.plain_text:
Severstal became a vertically integrated steel and mining group during Alexey Mordashov's nineteen years as chief executive. He directed production modernisation, extended the company beyond its original plant and combined steelmaking with raw-material assets. The operating model placed control of inputs alongside finished-steel production and gave the group a broader industrial base.

After moving from daily management to board leadership, Mordashov continued as Severstal's chairman and largest shareholder. In Cherepovets, a charitable foundation created at his initiative supports families in difficult circumstances and programmes for talented children. He has also backed long-running urban-development projects in the city.
